User: Peter and his dad Rupert shared the same birthday.  To make it special, they each got their own birthday cake.  Peter has 10 candles on his cake.  Rupert is 3 and 1/2 times older than Peter.  How many candles will be on Rupert's cake?
Assistant: <think>

The combined age of Peter and his dad is 10 + 3.5 = 13.5 years. Since age is typically expressed in whole numbers, we can assume the combined age is 14 (rounding up because you can't have half a candle). So, Rupert's cake will have 14 candles on it. </think> <answer> 14 </answer>
